purpose: Compare optimizer recovery from three independently degraded search policies
selection_rule: Compare only independently held-out Elo recovery from each degraded start
primary_metric: Mean held-out Elo recovery at 1000 training games across starts
secondary_metric: Normalized trapezoidal area under the held-out recovery curve
decision_rule: Call methods tied unless their paired 95% difference interval excludes zero
notes: All methods receive the same centered parameter box, fixed master opponent, and openings.
The master policy is inside every box but is not identified to the optimizer.
SPSA is planned for the full horizon and cannot reuse the shorter pilot trajectory.
RBFOpt points are plotted at the actual number of games consumed.
Internal optimizer estimates are diagnostic and never enter the common learning curve.
